notes.title: V1.1.154 Update
notes.content:
1. Add manual combat mode, the default mode is automatic combat, you can cancel the automatic combat by check in the lower left corner of the map area in the game, let our battle control manually.
2. Optimize some performance.

I'm sorry that I haven't updated it for so long. The author has been busy with work, including another free game "Pkuxkx" that the author has participated in maintenance. There is no time to update. I was free these days, so I immediately spent 3 days in "Pkuxkx" to update the team PK game like Battle Royale, and then the game immediately thought of this idea to update.
The biggest problem with this game idea is the UI. Some ideas suffer from not having time to study UI design and cannot be implemented.
The author has been developing new content to "Pkuxkx" for about 3 years. The author will continue to maintain and develop it when i am  free.

notes.title: hotfix V1.0.127
notes.content:
Fix the issue that the V1.0.126 version cannot run

At noon, in order to fix the bug, I temporarily set up an environment in the company computer. After the release, I went to a nap without verification. It may still be a problem with the environment. The game could not run directly. Until the evening I receive user feedback and fixed immediately. After finishing the work, I immediately drived home to reissue the version.
I'm verry sorry for my friends.

tags.bug: Fix the issue that the V1.0.126 version cannot run

notes.title: hotfix V1.0.126

tags.bug: 1. Repair the abnormal problem of heal skills caused by the loss of animation resources;
2. Fixed the problem that the game will not be over if the final month fails. After the repair, the old save can be played for next month and then over;
3. Fix the problem that the heal skill will be casted when full of HP;

tags.feature: 1. Added the automatic archive function. The path is the save folder in the game directory. It is divided into the last manual archive (game.dat_manual) and the last automatic archive (game.dat_auto). If there is a problem with the archive, you can manually restore it (it should not be this question);
2.3 additional difficulties will no longer be opened at the beginning, you need to clear the previous difficulty before unlocking;

notes.title: Hotfix V1.0.118
notes.content:
Fixed several bugs found in self-test and adjusted the values of the lobby and pharmacy.

Because it is the developer's self-test, there may be some bugs that have not been found. Welcome friends to feedback via email xy_conan@aliyun.com.
Sorry to the friends for the game's bugs, the author will continue to follow up on this product.
There is still some ideas in the author's mind, but there is still a question about art resource. No matter what, the author will stick to it.
